notes:
New Features:

- Adds .com EOF classification that checks whether the currently used HLS feed is still advancing after Kodi stops and whether a freshly resolved website stream is available.
- .com recovery now waits for a real Kodi playback end instead of interrupting a still-running stream on the first media-sequence reset; a fresh stream is opened only when the EOF is confirmed and the website still provides a playable source.

Improvements:

- .com diagnostics run every 15 seconds and also track playback progress versus wall-clock time, making long stalls visible without forcing an early restart.
- Adult IPTV disables the stale remote M3U cache again and uses IPTV Simple startup connection checks so a temporary m3u4u failure can retry without pinning an old channel list.
- Release Notes in the Settings tab can now be scrolled with Up/Down, Page Up/Page Down and the mouse wheel.

Bugfixes:

- Fixes v1.114 restarting .com streams immediately on a media-sequence reset even when the browser-style source could continue.
- Fixes Adult IPTV loading an outdated cached playlist snapshot such as the 16-channel list seen in the latest test.
- Fixes the Settings Release Notes tab swallowing directional navigation instead of scrolling long notes.
